ui.introduction: Hello! My name is Luca. I am a designer, coder, and tinkerer.

about.bio:
Hi! My name is Luca.

I am from Seattle, WA and I like to make things.
I am a product designer and web developer with experience in React and Swift.

I have always appreciated design that is simple and intuitive, and I hope to build tools and experiences for people that are thoughtful and help the world.
